decisions.rationale: Lead Incineroar+Metagross: FakeOut Politoed to prevent rain setup turn 1, Mega MeteorMash pressures Scizor/Archaludon. Clear Body ignores Intimidate from Staraptor. decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Rain core (Politoed+Scizor-Mega+Archaludon). Noivern Tailwind/Hurricane is primary win condition. Opponent Protects after heavy damage. decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Scizor-Mega. Noivern (192 Spe, Focus Sash) is the fastest mon on the field and nearly guarantees Tailwind T1; Scizor Protects to Mega Evolve safely. With Tailwind up, Scizor-Mega outspeeds the entire opposing team and Close Combat KOs Incineroar (2x SE). Metagross-Mega cannot hurt Scizor-Mega (all its moves are 0.5x) — that is the hard wincon. Politoed back for Drizzle to override Torkoal sun and Weather Ball chip; Archaludon late for Electro Shot sweeps under speed control. Mamos
decisions.notebook: G2 lead plan: Noivern+Scizor lead, Politoed+Archaludon back. Scizor-Mega is sole Mega. Key confirmed matchups: Close Combat neutral vs Metagross (Fighting 2x Steel / 0.5x Psychic = 1x), SE vs Incineroar (2x). Metagross-Mega Meteor Mash/Ice Punch/Bullet Punch all 0.5x vs Scizor-Mega — unbreakable wall, primary wincon. Mamoswine Ice Shard 4x vs Noivern (Focus Sash saves once). Risk: if opp leads Mamoswine+Metagross and double-priority-targets Noivern, Sash breaks then KO before Tailwind — must respect this; if seen at preview, consider Grimmsnarl lead instead for Prankster screens. Politoed Weather Ball in rain becomes Water-type (SE vs Torkoal/Incineroar). Archaludon Electro Shot 130 BP STAB + Life Orb is premier late-game nuke but vulnerable to Mamoswine HHP (SE) and needs speed control active. Opponent won G1; may keep same bring (Metagross/Incineroar/Torkoal/Mamoswine) or adjust to Meowscarada/Hatterene. If Hatterene appears, watch for TR + Magic Bounce blocking screens; Noivern Super Fang is key chip tool. For potential G3: if this bring loses, consider Grimmsnarl over Noivern for Prankster screen safety vs priority-heavy leads.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out on Noivern attempts flinch to prevent Hurricane/Super Fang or Tailwind. Ice Punch is 4x SE on Flying/Dragon Noivern, breaking Focus Sash regardless. Scizor's Close Combat on Incineroar is 2x but -1 Atk from Intimidate; Focus Sash guarantees survival at 1 HP. This removes Noivern's speed control threat while preserving Incineroar for Parting Shot or Flare Blitz next turn. Mega Evolution deferred since Tough Claws doesn't boost Ice Punch.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Rain core (Politoed+Scizor-Mega+Archaludon). Noivern Tailwind/Hurricane primary win condition. Must pressure Politoed turn 1 when it enters to prevent rain setup. Grimmsnarl Prankster screens untested. Incineroar Focus Sash critical for surviving super-effective hits. Opponent Protects after heavy damage—anticipate Protect when threatening KOs.

decisions.rationale: Tailwind+Protect+Mega covers most lines: Scizor Protect(+4) beats Fake Out flinch, Megas into 140 Def wall. If Fake Out targets Noivern, lose Tailwind but keep Mega Scizor. Protect+EQ leaves Torkoal too healthy and Archaludon still dies.

reflections.summary: The win resulted from successfully pivoting to the Incineroar/Torkoal core to override rain with Drought, then leveraging Torkoal's super-effective Earth Power and Heat Wave to clean up the remaining rain setup and Mega Scizor. The team-preview plan was fundamentally flawed: bringing Metagross-Mega and Mamoswine against a Politoed/Archaludon rain core created a severe type disadvantage, as both were hard-countered by rain-boosted Water and Electric moves. The intended Mega Metagross was poorly s
reflections.adjustment: In Game 3, abandon the Metagross/Mamoswine lead against rain and instead open with Incineroar/Torkoal to immediately establish sun, neutralize Drizzle, and apply consistent pressure without risking early double-KOs.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's rain core (Politoed/Archaludon) is fully eliminated; remaining viable pool is Grimmsnarl and Staraptor. Opponent heavily relies on Helping Hand to enable partner sweeps. Drought reliably overrides Drizzle on switch-in. Metagross-Mega/Mamoswine pairing is structurally weak to rain-boosted attacks and should be avoided in this series. Expect Prankster screens/Spirit Break from Grimmsnarl and Intimidate/Brave Bird/Final Gambit from Staraptor in Game 3; prepare for Intimidate cycling and priority disruption. Track weather turn counts and avoid contact moves against Stamina targets.

reflections.summary: Lost because Scizor-Mega was brought into a sun matchup where Torkoal's Heat Wave/Eruption is 4x super effective and always KO. After Archaludon fell to Torkoal's Earth Power on turn 7 (EQ+HH couldn't KO from full), Scizor-Mega was forced in and auto-lost to sun-boosted Heat Wave on turn 8. The team-preview plan was the root flaw: Scizor-Mega has no safe role against a Torkoal sun core, and Politoed's Drizzle was overridden by Drought, leaving no answer to Torkoal once Archaludon was removed.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Scizor-Mega if opponent keeps Torkoal. Either lead with a plan to remove Torkoal before Scizor ever touches the field, or swap the Mega slot entirely. Prioritize KOing Torkoal early—Archaludon cannot reliably KO it with EQ alone, so stack damage or use a different breaker. Consider Grimmsnarl screens to let Archaludon survive Earth Power.
reflections.notebook:
Opponent roster: Metagross-Mega (Jolly, Meteor Mash/Bullet Punch/Ice Punch/Protect), Incineroar (Impish, Focus Sash, Fake Out/Flare Blitz/Parting Shot/Protect), Torkoal (Quiet, Charcoal, Drought, Eruption/Heat Wave/Earth Power/Protect), Mamoswine (Adamant, Life Orb, Thick Fat, Ice Shard/High Horsepower/Rock Slide/Protect), Meowscarada (Jolly, Expert Belt, Protean, not brought G2), Hatterene (Quiet, Leftovers, Magic Bounce, TR, not brought G2). G2 brought: Metagross+Mamoswine+Incineroar+Torkoal.

Durable facts: Torkoal Drought overrides Politoed Drizzle. Torkoal carries Earth Power (not just Fire STAB). Incineroar Focus Sash confirmed. Torkoal Earth Power KOs Archaludon at 63% HP. Archaludon EQ+HH does 26-56% to Torkoal from full—not a reliable KO. Scizor-Mega 4x Fire weak, auto-loses to any Torkoal Fire move under sun. Sun weakens Politoed Weather Ball and Ice Beam is insufficient damage. Incineroar at 5% with Sash already broken: Fake Out unusable after turn 1, Parting Shot only useful for stat drops.

G3 plan: Scizor-Mega is a bad bring vs Torkoal sun—consider dropping it or guaranteeing Torkoal removal before Scizor enters. Need reliable Torkoal KO path (Archaludon EQ alone insufficient). Grimmsnarl over Noivern for Prankster screens to help Archaludon survive Earth Power and check priority-heavy leads. Watch for opponent swapping in Meowscarada or Hatterene-TR for G3.
